title: China-to-Bosnia and Herzegovina BESS Compliance Gap Matrix
target_market: Bosnia and Herzegovina (BAS / DERK / NOS BiH)
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: BESS Fire-Safety and Local Installation Review
rows.target_requirement: Bosnia and Herzegovina BESS projects may require local fire-authority, municipality, insurer, and project-owner review in addition to CE-aligned product evidence. BAS and the official project framework are used for technical references, while practical acceptance is often tied to local fire and installation conditions rather than a single national whole-unit BESS fire certificate.
target_standards: Bosnia and Herzegovina public installation safety expectations for electrical energy systems
BAS references for CE-oriented product and electrical documentation
Local fire-authority and municipality installation review process
rows.china_equivalent: China commonly uses GB 44240-2024, GB/T 36276-2023, and GB/T 36558 for energy-storage lithium and system safety references, including fire and thermal-risk review. These reports can support a Bosnia-facing dossier but do not replace country-side fire and installation approval obligations.
rows.gap: Do not assume a Chinese domestic fire report is sufficient. Prepare a Bosnia-specific fire dossier: enclosure design, cell chemistry, thermal-runaway mitigation, detection and suppression concept, ventilation or gas analysis, spacing, access routes, emergency shutoff, commissioning tests, and Turkish-language is not required, but Bosnia-relevant operator language must be aligned with site documents.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where the Bosnia and Herzegovina local fire authority, municipality, insurer, or project owner requires site-level fire evidence; no national blanket certificate is stated as a legal substitute here
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory or project-specific depending on Chinese product approval and destination-site requirements

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Product safety evidence does not replace Bosnia local fire and installation review. Treat fire design and commissioning conditions as project-specific approval items.

source.publisher: Government of Bosnia and Herzegovina and local civil-protection/fire authorities

rows.requirement: DERK and NOS BiH Grid-Connection and Market Participation Review
rows.target_requirement: Bosnia and Herzegovina reviews storage projects through DERK and the Independent System Operator (NOS BiH) according to connection point, installed capacity, market role, and support-service route, including import/export corridor and balancing context. For Croatia-linked corridor exports, confirm transport and project linkage through the Ploče corridor process. For Bosnia-facing BESS files, provide DERK market classification, interconnection protocol, interconnection documents, grid-study outputs, metering, protection-coordination evidence, dispatch interfaces, commissioning evidence, and site readiness records before energisation.
target_standards: Bosnia and Herzegovina electricity market and interconnection implementation references used by DERK
NOS BiH grid code and operating practice at the project connection point
IEC 62933-5-2 for internationally expected grid-integrated BESS evidence where project rules require
rows.china_equivalent: China often uses GB/T 36558-2023 and related utility procedures for storage project grid studies and integration planning. These materials can support technical mapping but do not replace Bosnia-specific DERK and NOS BiH project pathway and interconnection decisions.
china_standards: China State Grid and China Southern Power Grid interconnection planning references
rows.gap: The key gap is Bosnia project pathway and operation model. Exporters should confirm whether the BESS is treated as storage, embedded generation, or capacity resource by DERK and NOS BiH, and map protection settings, anti-islanding logic, reactive-power settings, import current limits, voltage profiles, and operating interfaces before project acceptance.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where Bosnia and Herzegovina projects require DERK classification, NOS BiH interconnection documentation, market participation approval, or project-specific operational route
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — China GB/T project evidence is not Bosnia DERK/NOS BiH grid-approval proof

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Keep grid interconnection and market participation separate from product-safety documents. Bosnia projects require route-specific DERK and NOS BiH checks even when test evidence is complete.

source.publisher: State Electricity Regulatory Commission (DERK), Bosnia and Herzegovina; NOS BiH

rows.requirement: CE-Aligned Electrical Safety and BESS Standards
rows.target_requirement: Bosnia and Herzegovina is EU-candidate aligned and applies CE-oriented references for in-scope electrical products through BAS implementation programs. For lithium-ion BESS, IEC 62619 is commonly used as battery safety evidence, and IEC 62933-5-2 is commonly used as system safety evidence for grid-connected installations. Exporters should map model scope, voltage class, and country pathway before shipment.
target_standards: Bosnia and Herzegovina CE-oriented electrical safety implementation references via BAS
rows.china_equivalent: China commonly uses GB 44240-2024 and GB/T 36276-2023 for energy-storage lithium safety, and GB/T 36558 for system integration evidence. These reports support technical comparison but do not substitute for Bosnia-facing EN/IEC or project-specific evidence.
rows.gap: Do not assume China domestic GB battery safety evidence is sufficient for Bosnia filing. Prepare EN/IEC evidence aligned to Bosnia-facing scope, including voltage class, thermal management assumptions, isolation and protection design, risk analysis, and model-level declaration controls.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for in-scope electrical equipment when Bosnia-facing documentation and project files require EN/IEC evidence and BAS-compatible market placement
mandatory_status.cn: Not a direct substitute for Bosnia market placement or project acceptance requirements

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Keep Bosnia-facing EN/IEC evidence separate and model-specific. China GB battery safety reports are useful for technical mapping but not final market-placement proof in Bosnia.

source.publisher: Institute for Standardization of Bosnia and Herzegovina (BAS)

rows.requirement: Lithium Battery Transport — UN 38.3 and Dangerous Goods Documentation
rows.target_requirement: Lithium-ion cells and batteries shipped to Bosnia and Herzegovina normally need UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, Part III, subsection 38.3 transport test evidence and the related test summary before air, sea, road, or multimodal transport. Transport compliance is separate from Bosnia product conformity, BAS evidence, DERK/NOS BiH project approval, and grid interconnection.
target_standards: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, Part III, subsection 38.3
UN Model Regulations dangerous-goods framework for lithium batteries
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese exporters often hold UN 38.3 reports and transport-condition identification documents issued for outbound lithium-battery shipments. These documents can support Bosnia-bound shipment planning, but shippers must still match the exact cell, battery, module, state of charge, packaging, dangerous-goods declaration, and route rules for the actual transport corridor.
china_standards: UN 38.3 test report and lithium-battery test summary
China outbound dangerous-goods transport documentation for lithium batteries
rows.gap: A transport safety file does not substitute product compliance. Exporters should prepare model-specific UN 38.3 reports, test summaries, SDS, packing instructions, battery net mass information, state-of-charge controls, and carrier-required declarations for the selected Bosnia route.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for regulated lithium-battery transport where UN dangerous-goods rules are incorporated by the selected mode and route
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for regulated outbound lithium-battery transport documentation; not a substitute for destination product or grid approval

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] UN 38.3 is a transport gate, not Bosnia market access. Match test summaries and dangerous-goods package to the exact shipped battery configuration and chosen route.

source.publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE)
